en.ARGUMENT FORT : en 1855, la même branche: STRONG ARGUMENT: in 1855, the same branch of the Counts Waldstein (Münchengrätz line) owned Šťáhlavy (birthplace of Václav), Mnichovo Hradiště (Rečkov / Malá Bělá, where his cousin František lived) and, in Hungary, Borossebes and Monyásza (Menyháza, birthplace of György). The Macharowskýs, foresters of the Waldsteins, may have been transferred from one estate to another.
